assessments.reasoning: The exact published 0.29-gfm introduction identifies CommonMark as its base and calls the added syntax extensions. The tag and source material independently corroborate the historical basis.
The exact tagged release note supplies explicit historical corroboration of the CommonMark 0.29.0 implementation base. The formal document supplies the governing relationship.
The exact tagged source identifies the GFM document and its base relationship. Complete pair comparison verifies all 649 historical base fixtures are present in order.
The exact tagged Makefile separates the specification source and implementation extension test materials. This establishes their distinct roles and supplies contextual provenance for the comparison.
The historical upstream 0.29 document independently establishes the baseline fixture bytes. The GFM authority and tagged comparison establish the connection to this baseline.

challenge.method: Follow the annotated 0.29.0.gfm.0 tag to its target and reconstruct the commit's root tree digest. Compare complete paired Markdown and expected HTML fixture bodies by multiset, then test ordered preservation and earlier and later CommonMark editions.
challenge.results: The release note explicitly says the implementation moved to a 0.29.0 base. The tagged document preserves all 649 CommonMark 0.29 fixture pairs in original order and has 24 additional pairs, with 609 of 624 pairs from 0.28 and 627 of 652 from 0.31.2. The separate 26 runtime extension fixtures are a different file and do not supply the document comparison. This evidence corroborates historical scope without certifying an implementation.

limitations: Document lineage and fixture preservation do not establish deployed behavior, extension conformance or equivalence to CommonMark 0.31.2.
